understanding.english_query: maximum time limit for police detention in police station before production before magistrate
missing_facts: whether the person is an accused in a non-cognizable offense
whether the person is being held for questioning or formal arrest
whether the person has been formally arrested

summary_en: A person arrested by the police must be produced before a magistrate within 24 hours, excluding travel time. Police cannot keep a person in custody longer than 24 hours unless a magistrate grants a special order for further detention.
summary_ur: پولیس کے ذریعے گرفتار کیے گئے شخص کو سفر کے وقت کے علاوہ 24 گھنٹوں کے اندر مجسٹریٹ کے سامنے پیش کرنا ضروری ہے۔ پولیس کسی شخص کو 24 گھنٹوں سے زیادہ عرصے تک حراست میں نہیں رکھ سکتی جب تک کہ مجسٹریٹ مزید حراست کا کوئی خصوصی حکم نہ دے۔

steps.text_en: The Constitution requires that every person arrested must be brought before a magistrate within 24 hours of the arrest, not counting the time it takes to travel to the nearest court.
steps.text_ur: آئین دستور کے مطابق، ہر گرفتار شخص کو گرفتاری کے 24 گھنٹوں کے اندر مجسٹریٹ کے سامنے پیش کرنا ضروری ہے، جس میں قریبی عدالت تک سفر کا وقت شامل نہیں ہے۔
steps.quote: Every person who is arrested and detained in custody shall be produced before a magistrate within a period of twenty-four hours of such arrest, excluding the time necessary for the journey from the place of arrest to the court of the nearest magistrate,

steps.text_en: Under the Code of Criminal Procedure, a police officer cannot keep an arrested person in custody for more than 24 hours, excluding travel time, unless they obtain a special order from a magistrate.
steps.text_ur: کرمنائی ضابطہ فوجداری کے تحت، پولیس افسر گرفتار شخص کو سفر کے وقت کے علاوہ 24 گھنٹوں سے زیادہ عرصے تک حراست میں نہیں رکھ سکتا، جب تک کہ وہ مجسٹریٹ سے مزید حراست کا کوئی خصوصی حکم حاصل نہ کر لے۔
steps.quote: No police-officer shall detain in custody a person arrested without warrant for a longer period than under all the circumstances of the case is reasonable, and such period shall not, in the absence of a special order of a Magistrate under section 167, exceed twenty-four hours exclusive of the time necessary for the journey from the place of arrest to the Magistrate’s Court.

missing_facts: location of the shop

summary_en: You can file a complaint with the Authority regarding the goods sold or any unfair trade practice. Once the complaint is examined, the Authority will serve a notice to the respondent, who must reply within seven days.
summary_ur: آپ فروخت شدہ سامان یا کسی غیر منصفانہ تجارتی عمل کے خلاف اتھارٹی کے پاس شکایت درج کروا سکتے ہیں۔ شکایت کی جانچ کے بعد، اتھارٹی جوابدہ شخص کو نوٹس بھیجے گی جس کا جواب سات دنوں کے اندر دینا ہوگا۔

steps.text_en: A person can file a complaint with the Authority regarding any goods sold or any unfair trade practice.
steps.text_ur: ایک شخص فروخت شدہ کسی بھی سامان یا کسی غیر منصفانہ تجارتی عمل کے بارے میں اتھارٹی کے پاس شکایت درج کروا سکتا ہے۔
steps.quote: A complainant may in respect of any goods sold or delivered or any service provided or supplied or against any unfair trade practice file a complaint with the Authority.

steps.text_en: If the Authority believes a consumer's right has been violated, it will serve a notice to the respondent, who must provide a reply within seven days.
steps.text_ur: اگر اتھارٹی کو لگتا ہے کہ صارف کے کسی حق کی خلاف ورزی ہوئی ہے، تو وہ جوابدہ شخص کو نوٹس بھیجے گی، جس کا جواب سات دنوں کے اندر دینا ہوگا۔
steps.quote: Where on examination of the complaint received under sub- section (1) or sub- section (2), the Authority is of the opinion that any right of the consumer has been infringed, it shall cause the notice of the complaint to be served on the respondent who shall be required to give his reply within a period of seven days.

sources.title: Procedure for disposal of the complaints
sources.scope_note: Extent clause: Islamabad Capital Territory. Extent clause: "It extends to the Islamabad Capital Territory."

quotes.text: A complainant may in respect of any goods sold or delivered or any service provided or supplied or against any unfair trade practice file a complaint with the Authority.

understanding.english_query: legal requirement of sending a formal notice before filing a consumer court case for defective goods
missing_facts: whether a formal complaint was already lodged with the shop

summary_en: Yes, you must send a written notice to the seller or manufacturer before filing a case in Consumer Court. You must also provide proof that they received the notice and failed to respond. The claim must be filed within 30 days of the issue occurring, though the court may grant an extension under specific conditions.
summary_ur: جی ہاں، کنزیومر کورٹ میں مقدمہ درج کروانے سے پہلے آپ کو فروخت کنندہ یا مینوفیکچرر کو تحریری نوٹس بھیجنا ضروری ہے۔ آپ کو یہ بھی ثبوت دینا ہوگا کہ انہیں نوٹس مل گیا ہے لیکن انہوں نے جواب نہیں دیا۔ مقدمہ وقوعہ کے 30 دنوں کے اندر فائل کرنا ہوگا، تاہم عدالت مخصوص شرائط کے تحت توسیع دے سکتی ہے۔

steps.text_en: You are required to send a written notice to the manufacturer or service provider informing them that the product is defective and asking them to fix it or provide compensation.
steps.text_ur: آپ کو مینوفیکچرر یا سروس فراہم کنندہ کو تحریری نوٹس بھیجنا ہوگا جس میں انہیں مطلع کیا جائے کہ پروڈکٹ ناقص ہے اور ان سے اسے درست کرنے یا معاوضہ دینے کا مطالبہ کیا جائے۔
steps.quote: A consumer who has suffered damage, or Authority in other cases, shall, by written notice, call upon a manufacturer or provider of services that a product or service is defective or faulty, or the conduct of the manufacturer or service provider is in contravention of the provisions of this Act and he should remedy the defects or give damages where the consumer has suffered damage, or cease to contravene the provisions of this Act.

steps.text_en: The Consumer Court will not accept your claim unless you have sent this notice and can prove that the seller received it but did not reply.
steps.text_ur: کنزیومر کورٹ آپ کے دعوے پر تب تک غور نہیں کرے گا جب تک آپ یہ نوٹس نہ بھیجیں اور یہ ثبوت نہ دیں کہ فروخت کنندہ کو نوٹس مل گیا ہے لیکن اس نے جواب نہیں دیا۔
steps.quote: No claim shall be entertained by a Consumer Court unless the consumer or the Authority has given notice under sub-section (1) and provides proof that the notice was duly delivered but the manufacturer or service provider has not responded thereto.

sources.title: Settlement of Claims
sources.scope_note: Provincial code portal version. Extent clause: "It shall extend to the whole of the Province of the Punjab."

quotes.text: A consumer who has suffered damage, or Authority in other cases, shall, by written notice, call upon a manufacturer or provider of services that a product or service is defective or faulty, or the conduct of the manufacturer or service provider is in contravention of the provisions of this Act and he should remedy the defects or give damages where the consumer has suffered damage, or cease to contravene the provisions of this Act.

No claim shall be entertained by a Consumer Court unless the consumer or the Authority has given notice under sub-section (1) and provides proof that the notice was duly delivered but the manufacturer or service provider has not responded thereto.

summary_en: If a police station head refuses to register a First Information Report (FIR) without a valid reason, the District Public Safety Commission can order an inquiry. The police officer must then conduct the inquiry, register the FIR if a cognizable offense is found, and report the action taken to the Commission within 48 hours.
summary_ur: اگر تھانے کا انچارج بلاوجہ پہلی اطلاع رپورٹ (FIR) درج کرنے سے انکار کرے تو ڈسٹرکٹ پبلک سیفٹی کمیشن انکوائری کا حکم دے سکتا ہے۔ پولیس افسر کو چاہیے کہ وہ انکوائری کرے، اگر قابلِ دست اندازی جرم ہو تو ایف آئی آر درج کرے اور 48 گھنٹوں کے اندر کمیشن کو کارروائی کی اطلاع دے۔

steps.text_en: The District Public Safety Commission has the authority to intervene if they believe a police station head is unfairly refusing to register an FIR.
steps.text_ur: ڈسٹرکٹ پبلک سیفٹی کمیشن کے پاس مداخلت کا اختیار ہے اگر انہیں یقین ہو کہ تھانے کا انچارج غیر منصفانہ طور پر ایف آئی آر درج کرنے سے انکار کر رہا ہے۔
steps.quote: direct the District Police Officer or City Police Officer in writing, where the District Public Safety Commission has reasons to believe that the head of the police station has unjustifiably refused or avoided to register any First Information Report,

steps.text_en: If the allegations show a cognizable offense, the officer must register the FIR.
steps.text_ur: اگر الزامات سے قابلِ دست اندازی جرم ظاہر ہو تو افسر کو ایف آئی آر درج کرنی ہوگی۔
steps.quote: cause the registration of the First Information Report under section 154 of the Code, if any cognizable case is made out from the allegations of the complainant

steps.text_en: The police officer must report the action taken to the District Public Safety Commission within forty-eight hours.
steps.text_ur: پولیس افسر کو چوالیس گھنٹوں کے اندر ڈسٹرکٹ پبلک سیفٹی کمیشن کو کی گئی کارروائی کی اطلاع دینی ہوگی۔
steps.quote: report to the District Public Safety Commission within forty-eight hours the action taken by him;
